editorial:
Imagine a killer who turns murder into a live internet show where the more people watch, the faster the victim dies. That is the chilling setup of this cybercrime thriller. You follow Special Agent Jennifer Marsh, a tough FBI agent who hunts online criminals, as she faces a sadistic killer who streams his crimes for the world to see. The story pulls you in fast with its dark, tense mood and keeps you guessing about who is behind the screen. Diane Lane brings real grit to the lead role, making you care about her fight to stop the madness. The movie mixes police work with modern tech fears in a way that feels scary and real.

The pacing is quick and the tension stays high from start to finish. You get solid action, some clever detective work, and a few genuinely creepy moments. On the downside, the plot can feel a bit predictable and some characters are not fully developed. Still, if you enjoy dark thrillers with a tech twist, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Marsh tracks the killer to his hidden lair after he kidnaps her partner. She discovers the killer is a man who blames the internet and society for his pain, using the website to punish people he sees as guilty. Marsh fights him in a brutal showdown and manages to save her partner. The killer is killed, and the website is shut down for good. Marsh walks away shaken but safe, having stopped the deadly online game.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark thrillers with a tech twist
